user.description: Zones and their heating and cooling units are set up on the Climate zones page, which appears in the sidebar once this is added.

set_idle_band.name: Set idle band
set_idle_band.description: The width of the band, centred on the target, where nothing runs. Heating starts below it, cooling above it.

idle_band.name: Idle band
idle_band.description: Its width in °C: 1.5 around a 24 °C target is 23.25 to 24.75.
